title: 第11章 叫我雪儿第12章 何小姐邀请
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
“去博城啊。”刘冰冰笑着说，“就是国内唯一可以合法赌博的地方，那边有个大型的娱乐城，特别好玩。”
“博城？”陈阳愣了一下，随即摇了摇头，“我就不去了，我没有通行证。”
他知道博城的特殊性，进博城需要专门的通行证。
刘冰冰眼中闪过一丝遗憾，点了点头，“那好吧，等你办好了通行证，我下次再带你去。”
她说完，朝陈阳挥了挥手。
升起车窗，发动车子。
白色的宝马车很快就驶离了凤鸣居。
陈阳站在原地，看着车子消失的方向，轻轻叹了口气。
本想借着陪伴她的机会，找个合适的时机提治疗的事。
没想到她要出去玩耍，计划只能暂时搁置了。
突然，他脑海里灵光一闪。
对了！
凭我的透视神通，到了博城，岂不是可以大展手脚，轻松赚钱？
这个念头一出，他的眼睛瞬间亮了起来。
他不再犹豫，转身快步上了迈巴赫，发动车子驶去。
十几分钟后，车子停在办证大厅。
办证大厅里人不算多，陈阳按照流程排队、提交材料、拍照，全程十分顺利。
不到一个小时，他就拿着崭新的博城通行证从办证大厅里走了出来。
对了，自己从来没去过博城，对那边的环境和规矩都不熟悉，得找个人带路才行！
就在这时，手机突然响了起来，屏幕上跳动着“林北”两个字。

陈阳眼睛一亮，连忙划开接听键：“林少，找我有事？”
“阳哥，你今天有空吗？要不要再去逛逛赌石街？”林北爽朗的声音从听筒里传来，显然还很惦记昨天和陈阳一起逛赌石的乐趣。
“赌石街今天就不去了。”陈阳笑着说：“林少，博城你去过没？”
“博城？去过啊！”林北的声音里带着一丝惊讶，“阳哥，你想去博城？”
“对，我想去那边玩两把，但我从来没去过，对那边不熟。”陈阳直言不讳，“要不你现在有空，给我带个路？”
林北的语气瞬间变得有些无奈：“阳哥，博城我倒是熟，可我在那边被封杀了，根本进不去娱乐城。”
他顿了顿，又连忙说，“不过你别担心，我找个人带你去，你现在在哪？”
“那也行。”陈阳点点头，“我在办证大厅门口，我给你发个定位。”
“好嘞！”林北应了一声，挂断了电话。
陈阳打开微，将自己的实时定位发给了林北。
然后靠在迈巴赫的车身上等待。
大约十分钟后，一阵引擎的轰鸣声传来。
陈阳抬头望去，只见一辆白色的保时捷跑车缓缓驶来，稳稳地停在他的车旁。
车门打开，一个娇俏的身影从车上走了下来。
正是孙雪儿。
她今天穿了一条白色的百褶短裙，搭配着洁白的袜子和一双干净的小白鞋。
乌黑的长发扎成了一个高高的马尾，露出了纤细白皙的脖颈。
整个人看起来青春活力十足，像个刚走出校园的中学生。
陈阳一下很是意外。
content_en:
"Go to Bo City." Liu Bingbing said with a smile, "It's the only place in the country where gambling is legal. There is a large entertainment city there, which is very fun."
"Bo City?" Chen Yang was stunned for a moment, then shook his head, "I won't go, I don't have a pass."
He knows the special nature of Bo City, and a special pass is required to enter Bo City.
A trace of regret flashed in Liu Bingbing's eyes, and she nodded, "Well, after you get the pass, I will take you there next time."
After she finished speaking, she waved to Chen Yang.
Raise the windows and start the car.
The white BMW quickly drove away from Fengmingju.
Chen Yang stood there, looking at the direction in which the car disappeared, and sighed softly.
I wanted to take the opportunity of accompanying her to find a suitable time to mention the treatment.
Unexpectedly, she wanted to go out to play, so the plan had to be put on hold temporarily.
Suddenly, an idea flashed in his mind.
That’s right!
With my clairvoyant powers, wouldn't it be possible to show off my skills and make money easily when I arrive in Bo City?
As soon as this thought came out, his eyes lit up instantly.
He no longer hesitated, turned around and quickly got into the Maybach, started the car and drove off.
Ten minutes later, the car stopped at the permit application hall.
There were not many people in the certificate application hall. Chen Yang lined up, submitted materials, and took photos according to the process. The whole process went very smoothly.
In less than an hour, he walked out of the certification hall with a brand new Bo City pass.
By the way, I have never been to Bo City, and I am not familiar with the environment and rules there. I have to find someone to guide me!
At this moment, the phone suddenly rang, and the word "Lin Bei" danced on the screen.
Chen Yang's eyes lit up and he quickly opened the answer button: "Mr. Lin, do you have anything to do with me?"
"Brother Yang, are you free today? Do you want to go shopping on Stone Gambling Street again?" Lin Bei's hearty voice came from the receiver, obviously still thinking about the fun of visiting Stone Gambling Street with Chen Yang yesterday.
"I won't go to Gambling Street today." Chen Yang said with a smile: "Mr. Lin, have you been to Bo City?"
"Bo City? Have you been there!" Lin Bei's voice was filled with surprise, "Brother Yang, do you want to go to Bo City?"
"Yes, I want to go there and play a few games, but I've never been there before and I'm not familiar with it." Chen Yang said bluntly, "Why don't you show me the way now that you're free?"
Lin Bei's tone suddenly became a little helpless: "Brother Yang, I am familiar with Bo City, but I was banned there and can't enter the entertainment city at all."
He paused and then said quickly, "But don't worry, I'll find someone to take you there. Where are you now?"
"That's okay." Chen Yang nodded, "I'm at the door of the certification hall. I'll send you the location."
"Okay!" Lin Bei responded and hung up the phone.
Chen Yang opened WeChat and sent his real-time location to Lin Bei.
Then he leaned against the body of the Maybach and waited.
About ten minutes later, the roar of an engine came.
Chen Yang looked up and saw a white Porsche sports car slowly approaching and parked steadily next to his car.
The car door opened, and a pretty figure stepped out of the car.
It was Sun Xueer.
Today she wore a white pleated skirt, paired with white socks and a pair of clean white shoes.
Her long black hair was tied into a high ponytail, revealing her slender white neck.
The whole person looks youthful and energetic, like a middle school student who has just stepped out of campus.
Chen Yang was very surprised.
